gui.kreno.config.title: Kreno Config
gui.kreno.config.entry.compress.compress: The compression level for packets, between 1-9.
gui.kreno.config.entry.fix.issues128.syn: Run bandwidth statistics on sync thread, which is closer to Vanilla behavior.
gui.kreno.config.entry.mixin.loginVT.des: Replace player login validation thread with virtual thread
gui.kreno.config.entry.mixin.textFilterV: Replace text filter thread with virtual thread
gui.kreno.config.entry.mixin.utilVT.desc: Replace download thread with virtual thread
gui.kreno.config.entry.mixin.clientEncry: Enable new encryption optimizations on the client side
gui.kreno.config.entry.netty.allocatorMa: Change Netty's default 16MiB memory allocation to 4MiB, as Minecraft has a 2MiB packet size limit.
gui.kreno.config.entry.netty.happyEyebal: Enable Happy Eyeballs (RFC 8305) for client connections to race IPv6 and IPv4.
